panels.title: Duration percentiles

panels.description:
Backoff-scheduled re-runs per second, split by what triggered them. 

`success` = scheduled task reached the end of a cycle and is restarting on schedule (normal for periodic tasks). 

`failure` = attempt errored and the supervisor is retrying (flapping if this stays high). 

A one-shot task with restart=Never shows 0 here.
panels.title: Cycles by source

panels.description:
These are actual dead ends. 

`exhausted` = retry budget spent, task won't be restarted. 

`fatal` = task raised a non-retryable error. 

`timeout` = attempt exceeded its per-run deadline.
panels.title: Terminal & timeouts

panels.description:
Divergent view: positive = submissions accepted into the supervisor. 

Negative = submissions rejected by admission policy (slot busy, queue full, etc).

targets.expr: sum(rate(solti_ctrl_submissions_total[$__rate_interval]) * on (instance) group_left(agent) solti_build_info{agent=~"$agent"}) - sum(rate(solti_ctrl_rejections_total[$__rate_interval]) * on (instance) group_left(agent) solti_build_info{agent=~"$agent"})
